senses.definition: (dialectal, nonstandard) Pronunciation spelling of your, especially when preceded by a /t/ sound.

quotes.text: “Do you ever get cho acrylics done? Acrylics. You know, nails. Look at mine. I have them done every Thersday for my man. I bet yo’ man would like that.”
